'''Biel Borra Font''' (born 22 October 2005) is a [[association football|footballer]] who plays as a [[right back]] for Spanish [[Segunda Federación]] club [[UE Olot]]. Born in Spain, he made his debut for the [[Andorra national football team|Andorra national team]] in 2024.

==Club career==
Born in [[Barcelona]] to a father from [[Andorra]] and a mother from [[Banyoles]] in the [[Province of Girona]], Borra grew up in Banyoles.<ref name=girona>{{cite news |last1=Segura |first1=Arnau |title=Un andorrà-banyolí contra Anglaterra: «Fa il·lusió jugar amb aquest tipus de gent»|trans-title=An Andorran-Banyoles resident against England: "It's exciting to play with this type of people"|url=https://www.diaridegirona.cat/esports/2025/06/07/andorra-banyoli-anglaterra-fa-illusio-118328482.html |access-date=8 April 2026 |work=[[Diari de Girona]] |date=7 June 2025 |language=Catalan}}</ref> He began playing football aged 3 at {{ill|Unió Esportiva Porqueres|lt=UE Porqueres|ca}}, then [[CE Banyoles]], before joining the youth ranks of [[Girona FC]] at age 12.<ref name=mataro>{{cite news |last1=Bertran |first1=Malena |title=Biel Borra, el jove defensa del Vilassar internacional amb Andorra|trans-title=Biel Borra, Vilassar's young defender who is an international with Andorra|url=https://www.tvmataro.cat/ca/biel-borra-el-jove-defensa-del-vilassar-internacional-amb-andorra |access-date=8 April 2026 |publisher=TV Mataró |date=4 December 2025 |language=Catalan}}</ref>

After six years, Borra left Girona without making the first team, and signed for [[FC L'Escala]].<ref name=mataro/> In 2025, he signed for [[UE Vilassar de Mar]], also in the fifth-tier [[Tercera Federación]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Biel Borra, primer internacional de la UE Vilassar de Mar|trans-title=Biel Borra, first international of UE Vilassar de Mar|url=https://esportiumaresme.cat/biel-borra-primer-internacional-ue-vilassar-de-mar/ |access-date=8 April 2026 |publisher=Esportiu Maresme |date=4 November 2025 |language=Catalan}}</ref> After making 29 appearances, he moved up one division to [[UE Olot]] in the [[Segunda Federación]] in July 2026.<ref>{{cite news|first=Roger|last=Isern|title=Biel Borra es converteix en nou jugador de la Unió Esportiva Olot|trans-title=Biel Borra becomes new player of Unió Esportiva Olot|url=https://www.garrotxadigital.cat/noticia/269091/biel-borra-es-converteix-en-nou-jugador-de-la-unio-esportiva-olothttps://esportiumaresme.cat/|access-date=7 July 2026 |publisher=Garrotxa Digital|date=3 July 2026|language=Catalan}}</ref>

==International career==
Borra represented the [[Andorra national under-19 football team|Andorra national under-19 team]] from the age of 16.<ref name=girona/> On 21 November 2023, he scored an equaliser in a 2–1 comeback win against hosts [[Bulgaria national under-19 football team|Bulgaria]] in the last game of [[2024 UEFA European Under-19 Championship qualification]], overtaking Bulgaria to third place and one point off qualification to the next round.<ref>{{cite news |title=La sub-19 guanya Bulgària per 1-2 i es queda a un punt de classificar-se per l'Eurocopa|trans-title=Under-19 team defeat Bulgaria 1-2 and ended up one point from qualification for the European Championship |url=https://cadenaser.com/nacional/2023/11/22/la-sub-19-guanya-bulgaria-per-1-2-i-es-queda-a-un-punt-de-classificar-se-per-leurocopa-radio-ser-principat-d-andorra/ |access-date=8 April 2026 |publisher=[[Cadena SER]] |date=22 November 2023 |language=Catalan}}</ref>

Borra's debut for the [[Andorra national under-21 football team|under-21 team]] came at the age of 17 on 23 November 2022, in a 2–1 [[Exhibition game|friendly]] loss away to [[Malta national under-21 football team|Malta]].<ref>{{cite news |last1=Busuttil |first1=Antoine |title=Mattia Veselji, Andrea Zammit on target as Under-21s defeat Andorra 2-1 |url=https://www.maltafootball.com/2022/11/23/mattia-veselji-andrea-zammit-on-target-as-under-21s-defeat-andorra-2-1/#google_vignette |access-date=8 April 2026 |publisher=Malta Football |date=23 November 2022}}</ref>

On 3 September 2024, manager [[Koldo Álvarez]] called Borra up to the [[Andorra national football team|senior team]] for a friendly away to [[Gibraltar national football team|Gibraltar]] the next day.<ref>{{cite news |title=Biel Borra, novetat de l’absoluta a Gibraltar|trans-title=Biel Borra, new face for the senior team against Gibraltar|url=https://www.diariandorra.ad/esports/240903/biel-borra-novetat-l-absoluta-gibraltar_157400.html |access-date=8 April 2026 |work=[[Diari d'Andorra]] |date=3 September 2024 |language=Catalan}}</ref> He made his debut aged 18 by starting in the 1–0 loss at [[Europa Point Stadium]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Malta tampoc perdonarà|trans-title=Malta won't show mercy either|url=https://www.bondia.ad/esports/malta-tampoc-perdonara |access-date=8 April 2026 |work=[[Bondia (newspaper)|Bondia]] |date=5 September 2024 |language=Catalan}}</ref>

==Personal life==
As of 2025, Borra was studying a marketing degree through the [[Open University of Catalonia]].<ref name=girona/>
